Not really, although I suppose you could change the color of any of the sail paints to orange to keep with the Halloween theme.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Turns out this paint item can be collected by pets with Area Search (Land) skill at Island of New Guinea South Coast -- don't expect to farm 200 of them in five minutes of course, I expect it's a rare item even with max Pet Intimacy of 200.

Pets with Additional Discovery and Land Plunder skills also have a chance, but you have to make quest discoveries/beat up land battle enemies respectively to trigger those skills; collecting/procuring with Land Search is arguably a lot easier and more reliable as the item finding trigger can activate with each round of collection/procurement. Beats having to mess around with alchemy to acquire it, no? Cheers.

Source: blog.goo.ne.jp/cafe-hiyoko/e/cbaf3b2edc8cdd99ad57f04fd0d9615f (JP pet land collection loot guide)
